description: Chen Kui handoff reply phrases when case is ready for broker

customer_requested_human.zh: 好的，已帮您转给陈奎办公室，他们会尽快联系您。
customer_requested_human.en: Got it. We've forwarded your request to the office. They will contact you shortly.

add_car.zh: 加车要点已整理进本条服务记录，系统判断已满足本阶段可交办公室的条件。请在入口完成「正式提交办公室」后，同事才会在处理队列里接收并核对，随后出价并联系您（工作日优先，节假日顺延）。
add_car.zh_alt: 要点已写入本条服务记录；正式提交办公室后，同事会在队列中按记录核对、准备报价并与承保方沟通，有进展会联系您。
add_car.en: Your add-car details are captured on this service record and meet the handoff bar for this stage. After you complete formal submit in the portal, our office will receive it in the queue, verify, price, and follow up (weekdays first; holidays may delay).
add_car.en_alt: Your add-car details are on this service record. Once formally submitted to the office, our team will verify in the queue, prepare the quote, coordinate with carriers, then follow up.

add_car_supplement.zh: 已把这条补充记到同一条加车服务记录里；待您在入口正式提交办公室后，同事会按最新信息在队列中继续核对与报价准备。
add_car_supplement.en: I've added this to the same add-car service record—after formal submit to the office, our team will continue verification and quote prep in the queue using the latest details.

add_car_timeline.zh: 要点已齐时：下一步是在入口正式提交办公室。提交后由办公室按队列核对与处理；报价与后续联系以办公室核对与排队情况为准。
add_car_timeline.en: When details are complete, the next step is formal submit in the office queue. After that, quoting and follow-up are handled there—timing depends on verification and queue.

add_car_quote_detail.zh: 这类具体选项（如免赔额、保额组合）需要办公室结合车辆与驾驶信息核对后确认；已把你的关注点记到本条记录里，便于后续报价时参考。
add_car_quote_detail.en: Specific options like deductibles and coverage combinations need to be confirmed by our office based on vehicle and driver details—we've noted your concern on this record for quoting.

add_car_correction.zh: 已按你这次的最新说法更新同一条记录；正式提交办公室后，同事会按更新后的信息在队列中继续处理。
add_car_correction.en: We've updated this record to reflect your latest message—after formal submit, our office will proceed in the queue with the updated information.

add_car_office_receipt.zh: 若您关心办公室是否已看到本条记录：请先在入口完成「正式提交办公室」。提交后同事才会在处理队列里接收并核对；若尚未提交，我们无法代替办公室确认“已收到”。
add_car_office_receipt.en: If you are asking whether the office can see this record: please complete formal submit in the portal first—that is when our office can receive it in the queue. If you have not submitted yet, we cannot confirm office receipt.

add_car_office_receipt_submitted.zh: 这条加车记录已按正式提交进入办公室处理队列；办公室会按队列核对并与您联系。若您仍担心可见性，以入口「已提交」状态为准。
add_car_office_receipt_submitted.zh_alt: 若已点「正式提交办公室」，同事会在队列里按记录处理；入口「已提交」可作为是否送达的参考。
add_car_office_receipt_submitted.en: This add-car record is in the office queue after formal submit; our team will verify in the queue and follow up. If you are checking visibility, use the portal's submitted status as the source of truth.
add_car_office_receipt_submitted.en_alt: After formal submit, our team processes your record in the queue; use the portal submit status as the visibility check.

add_car_submitted.zh: 这条加车记录已正式送达办公室；办公室会按当前记录继续核对与处理。
add_car_submitted.zh_alt: 办公室已收到本条正式提交的加车记录；后续核对与联系会以当前服务记录为准。
add_car_submitted.en: This add-car record has been formally delivered to our office; our team will verify and continue from the current details.
add_car_submitted.en_alt: Your formal add-car submission is on file; verification and follow-up will use your current service record.

add_car_supplement_submitted.zh: 已把这次补充记到当前服务记录里；办公室会按更新后的记录继续处理。
add_car_supplement_submitted.zh_alt: 补充已写入同一条服务记录；办公室会按最新内容继续跟进。
add_car_supplement_submitted.en: I've added this update to your current service record; our office will continue from the updated details.
add_car_supplement_submitted.en_alt: Your update is saved on the same service record; our office will continue from the latest details.

add_car_timeline_submitted.zh: 这条记录已在办公室处理中；后续时间以办公室核对与排队进度为准。
add_car_timeline_submitted.zh_alt: 办公室侧排队处理中；具体等待时间以核对与队列进度为准，有节点变化会联系您。
add_car_timeline_submitted.en: This record is already with our office; timing depends on their verification queue.
add_car_timeline_submitted.en_alt: Your request is in the office queue; timing follows verification load—we will reach out when there is a meaningful update.

add_car_quote_detail_submitted.zh: 这类具体选项会结合当前记录继续核对；你的关注点已附到这条记录里，便于后续处理。
add_car_quote_detail_submitted.zh_alt: 条款/额度类细节要办公室结合记录核对后才能定；你的问题已记在记录里便于报价时对照。
add_car_quote_detail_submitted.en: Specific options will be confirmed against your current record; we've attached your note to this record for the next steps.
add_car_quote_detail_submitted.en_alt: Coverage and limit details must be confirmed against your record by our office; your question is noted for quoting.

add_car_correction_submitted.zh: 已按你这次的最新说法更新当前记录；办公室会按更新后的信息继续核对。
add_car_correction_submitted.en: We've updated the current record to match your latest message; our office will verify using the updated information.

remove_car.zh: 您说的卖车信息已整理好了，办公室会尽快处理，有结果会联系您。
remove_car.en: Got your vehicle removal details. Our office will process this and follow up with you.

other.zh: 您说的情况已整理好了，办公室会尽快处理，有结果会联系您。
other.en: Got it. We've noted your info—our office will review and follow up with you.

other_received.zh: 好的，收到了。办公室会尽快处理，有结果会联系您。
other_received.en: Got it, thanks. Our office will review this and follow up with you.

other_corrected.zh: 好的，明白了。办公室会尽快处理，有结果会联系您。
other_corrected.en: Got it, understood. Our office will review this and follow up with you.

other_clarification.zh: 您说的已收到，办公室会优先核实，有结果会联系您。
other_clarification.en: Got it. We'll prioritize verification and follow up with you.

stitched.description: High-frequency handoff-adjacent copy; matches former engine defaults for Chen Kui.

add_car_materials_sent.zh: 收到。办公室正核对您已发的加车材料；无需整套重发，缺项会主动联系您。
add_car_materials_sent.en: Thanks—our office is verifying what you sent for this add-car quote. No need to resend the full set; we will reach out only if something is still missing.

add_car_clarification_followup.zh: 收到。办公室按您已发资料逐条核对；仅在有缺项时再联系您。
add_car_clarification_followup.en: Got it. Our office will check what you sent line by line and only follow up if something is still missing.

why_still_chasing_reassurance.zh: 有时提醒和实际到账不同步。办公室会尽快核实；有结果会联系您。
why_still_chasing_reassurance.en: Reminders sometimes arrive before the file updates. Our office will verify and follow up with you.

prospective_send.zh_screenshot: 可以，截图先发我，办公室一起核。
prospective_send.zh_bundle: 可以，先发我，办公室一起核。
prospective_send.en_screenshot: Yes—send the screenshot and I will review it with your file.
prospective_send.en_bundle: Yes—send it over and I will bundle it for the office.

handoff_doc_clarification_suffix_add_car.zh: 。加车要点已记入本条记录；请在入口完成正式提交办公室后，由同事在队列中跟进，有结果会联系您。
handoff_doc_clarification_suffix_add_car.en: Your add-car details are on this record—after formal submit, our office will pick it up in the queue and follow up.

handoff_doc_clarification_suffix_other.zh: 。办公室会尽快处理，有结果会联系您。
handoff_doc_clarification_suffix_other.en: . Our office will process this and follow up with you.

handoff_add_car_coverage_answer.zh: 保额可以调整，报价时办公室会跟您确认。
handoff_add_car_coverage_answer.en: Coverage can be adjusted; the office will confirm options when quoting.

handoff_add_car_coverage_suffix.zh: 要点已记入本条记录；正式提交办公室后，同事会在队列中核对并尽快出价，有结果会联系您。
handoff_add_car_coverage_suffix.en: Details are on this record—after formal submit, our office will verify in the queue, price, and follow up.

handoff_payment_correction_urgency.zh: 您这边最要紧的是等办公室确认付款是否到账；如果确认了您这边就不用再做什么。办公室会尽快处理，有结果会联系您。
handoff_payment_correction_urgency.en: The most important thing for you now is to wait for our office to confirm whether the payment was received; if confirmed, you don't need to do anything else. Our office will process this and follow up with you.

handoff_add_car_contact_gap_tail.zh: 若姓名或电话尚未在本对话中写清，办公室后续联系时可能会先确认联系方式。
handoff_add_car_contact_gap_tail.en: If your name or phone isn't clear on this record yet, the office may confirm contact details when they reach out.
handoff_add_car_contact_gap_tail.zh_short: （若方便：请在本对话补一行姓名与电话，便于办公室联系。）
handoff_add_car_contact_gap_tail.en_short: (If you can, add your name and phone in one line here so the office can reach you.)

add_car_clarification_followup_submitted.zh: 收到。办公室会按当前服务记录与您已发资料继续核对；仅在有缺项时再联系您。
add_car_clarification_followup_submitted.en: Got it. Our office will continue checking against your current service record and what you sent, and will follow up only if something is still missing.

handoff_doc_clarification_suffix_add_car.zh: 。加车要点已记入本条办公室可见记录；办公室会按当前记录继续核对，有结果会联系您。
handoff_doc_clarification_suffix_add_car.en: Your add-car details are on the office-visible record; our office will continue verification from the current record and follow up.

handoff_add_car_coverage_suffix_submitte.zh: 要点已在办公室可见记录里；办公室会结合当前记录继续核对与报价准备，有结果会联系您。
handoff_add_car_coverage_suffix_submitte.en: The details are on the office-visible record; our office will continue verification and quote prep from the current record and follow up.

add_car_materials_sent_submitted.zh: 收到。办公室正按当前服务记录核对您已发的加车材料；无需整套重发，缺项会主动联系您。
add_car_materials_sent_submitted.en: Thanks—our office is verifying what you sent against your current add-car record. No need to resend the full set; we will reach out only if something is still missing.
